title: Private VPC Quickstart — networking & upgrade onboarding visuals
creator: Avery Chen
description: Create a small library of visual assets and annotated screenshots to support the Private/VPC quickstart in the Console and docs. Scope includes: 1) a simplified networking flow diagram that explains peer/VPC connector and routing decisions for non-network engineers; 2) 4 annotated step-by-step screenshots for the installer (CLI, Helm chart, and quick UI wizard); 3) upgrade UI mockups showing the new in-place upgrade modal, before/after states, and rollback affordances; 4) a condensed one-page PDF quickstart visual for sales/solution emails. Assets must be stylistically consistent with the Console UI, use the production color palette, and be exportable for web/docs and print. Deliverables should link to the PRD and a companion Figma file and include alt-text and captions for accessibility.
acceptance_criteria: A networking flow diagram (SVG + PNG) that clearly labels the role of customer VPC, Redwood control plane, and optional peering/gateway. Copy must be copy-edit-reviewed.
Four annotated installer screenshots covering: initial setup wizard, secret/KMS step, network validation errors, and success state. Each image includes callouts and short guidance.
Upgrade modal mockups for: start upgrade, progress with telemetry, post-upgrade success, and rollback confirmation. Mockups map to Console components and include microcopy suggestions.
Figma file with organized pages and version history; assets exported in 2x and 1x PNG and an SVG network diagram.
Docs PR opened with embedded images and captions; images meet accessibility alt-text requirements.
Sign-off from PM (Marcus Li) and Eng owner (Rohit Singh) in comments before marking Done.
screenshots_needed: Console wizard - initial cluster selection (show dropdown + description)
Console wizard - network configuration step (show validation errors and tooltips)
CLI install - terminal snippet with curl/helm commands and highlighted flags
Upgrade modal - confirming version selection and toggle for canary rollout
wireframe_notes: Use a left-to-right stepper for the quickstart flow, but collapse less-frequent advanced steps under an "expert" toggle.
Network diagram should emphasize traffic paths: control plane -> customer VPC (egress), optional peering path, and fallback to hosted mode.
Installer screenshots should surface common failure states (DNS, firewall rules) with short remediation hints.
Upgrade UI should show a progress bar with per-node progress dots and a single 'Abort & Rollback' CTA suppressed behind a confirmation.
